# MedInsight AI workspace guidance

- Treat all health outputs as educational context, never as diagnosis, triage, or a treatment plan.
- Preserve the source-provided reference range when analyzing laboratory values.
- Keep uncertainty, provenance, and escalation guidance visible in user-facing features.
- Do not add medication recommendations or imply clinical certainty.
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, and lucide-react.
- Backend: FastAPI under `backend/app`.
- Keep demo data clearly labeled until OCR, model inference, RAG retrieval, authentication, and persistence are implemented.
